name: Info Box
description: Informative boxes to highlight information, tips, warnings or success messages

info.name: Info Box
info.description: Informative box with light blue background

title.description: Box title or label (usually in bold)

content.description: Box content. Can be string or array of paragraphs

example.title: ℹ️ Information:
example.content: This is an informative box. Use to highlight important information or useful tips.

exampleHighlight.title: 💡 Highlight:
exampleHighlight.content: This is a highlight box. Use to draw attention to special information.

exampleSuccess.title: ✅ Success:
exampleSuccess.content: This is a success box. Use to show success messages or confirmations.

features: Three types: info, highlight and success
notes: Boxes are useful for highlighting important information. Use info for general information, highlight for warnings/tips and success for confirmations.
